# Non-academic Articles

<h2 class="entry-title expandable-title" onclick="toggleAbstract('desc-article-1')">México y su escalera educativa: todos suben, pero unos empiezan desde el sótano</h2>

*Mexico's educational ladder: everyone climbs, but some start in the basement*<br>[Este País (May 2026)](https://estepais.com/tendencias_y_opiniones/mexico-escalera-educativa-movilidad-social/)

<p id="desc-article-1" class="abstract-teaser" onclick="toggleAbstract('desc-article-1')">A look at the paradox of educational expansion in Mexico: each generation completes more years of schooling than the last, yet a parent's own education level remains the strongest predictor of a child's educational trajectory.</p>
